up: Retrieve approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for 'non-small cell lung carcinoma'. Join drug_indication, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures on molregno. Return columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term as indication_label, and drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind.
